covered_calls.title: Covered Call Strategy
covered_calls.subtitle: Weekly Options Income on Club Holdings
covered_calls.market_iv_context: VIX is elevated at 18.4 — above-average implied volatility across the market means option premiums are richer than normal this week, making covered calls more attractive.
covered_calls.covered_call_primer: A covered call means selling someone the right to buy your shares at a set price by a set date. You collect the premium today regardless of outcome. If the stock stays below the strike price, you keep the shares and the full premium. If it rises above the strike, your shares get called away at that price — you still profit, just capped at the strike.

plays.name: Apple Inc.
plays.viability_reason: Range-bound near support with no earnings for 6 weeks. IV elevated post-tariff news. Classic covered call setup.
plays.upcoming_catalyst: Q2 Earnings in ~6 weeks — ample time for a 30-day trade
plays.historical_win_rate: AAPL calls at 4-5% OTM have expired worthless approximately 72% of the time over the past 2 years based on historical options data.
plays.timing: Place at market open Monday. Target the May 17 $175 call. Collect ~$185 per contract.

plays.name: Microsoft Corp.
plays.viability_reason: Post-earnings consolidation phase. Stock range-bound between $385–$400. IV slightly elevated — good premium without excessive risk.
plays.historical_win_rate: MSFT calls at 3-5% OTM have expired worthless approximately 68% of the time over the past 2 years.
plays.timing: Place Monday at open. Target the May 17 $405 call. Collect ~$320 per contract.

plays.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
plays.viability_reason: Broad market ETF near recent highs. Low IV but consistent premium generator. Best for steady monthly income, not maximum yield.
plays.upcoming_catalyst: No earnings. Broad market events only.
plays.historical_win_rate: Broad ETF calls at 2-3% OTM have expired worthless approximately 78% of the time — the most consistent performer in the group.
plays.timing: Low urgency — place any time Monday or Tuesday. Target the May 17 $230 call.

plays.name: NVIDIA Corporation
plays.upcoming_catalyst: Q2 Earnings in 10 days — IV will spike dramatically into earnings, then crush post-report
plays.skip_reason: Earnings in 10 days — selling a covered call now locks in low premium while exposing you to a massive post-earnings gap. Wait until after the report.
plays.watch_for: Re-evaluate the day after earnings. Post-earnings IV expansion often creates the best covered call entry of the quarter.

key_insights: AAPL $175 call is the strongest play — high win rate, 4% OTM, 72% historical expiry worthless
Elevated VIX means richer-than-normal premiums across all viable plays this week
Skip NVDA entirely until after earnings — the risk/reward is unfavorable pre-report
